# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `agentconsult` MCP server pointing at BuyBox's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://buybox.agentconsult.ai/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth with Google sign-in (via Clerk, dynamic client registration) — no API key or client ID to configure.
